comments.text: Ancient monasteries on Meteora or Phugtal were originally built for solitude and quiet spiritual practice. But now that they’ve become viral tourist hotspots, isn't the fundamental essence of retreat and sacred serenity being commercialized and ruined by the constant influx of tourists?
